brique._comment: Native engine capability owned by the Trace family. Wrapper/runtime metadata fields do not apply here.

objective.name: trace.user
objective.description: Accept a user trace request and admit it into the local trace pipeline when the context trace policy allows it.

#root.role: Persist or decline one user-level trace request expressed as a capability call.

effects.trace_storage: May append one local user trace event to the context trace history when tracing is enabled and the user trace gate admits it.

transformation_contract.morphing: A user trace request becomes either one admitted local user trace event in the trace pipeline or a no-op acknowledgement when trace policy declines persistence.
invariants: The capability never exposes the trace JSONL internals to the caller.
The trace event, when admitted, is local to the addressed context.
The response reports admission into the trace pipeline, not durable write completion.
success: On success, the response payload contains status, accepted, and trace_kind.
When accepted is true, one user trace event has entered the local trace ingestion pipeline.
When accepted is false, the request was well-formed but local trace policy declined persistence.
failure: The capability fails invalid when required user trace params are missing or malformed.
The capability fails not_found when the trace family receives an unknown trace capability name through the same path.
The capability fails unavailable when the local trace ingestion ring cannot admit the requested user trace.
notes: This capability is intended to be called through a normal intention, including from wrappers.
trace.inspect remains the read surface for persisted traces and is not used to create user trace events.
